e.title: **法国农业多风险保单的**火灾纯保费**预测竞赛：把目标拆成**频率 × 案均 × 年数****：Kaggle 数据集 `mariodefrance/caa-challenge-2025`——**⭐ 逐字副标题**「**AssurPrime — ENS Challenge Data #161 (Crédit Agricole Assurances)**」**；**⭐ 目标逐字分解为** `CHARGE = FREQ × CM × ANNEE_ASSURANCE`**，**并要求两个模型**（**频率用 Poisson／log、**案均用 Tweedie／log**）**对** GLM 基准**算 RMSE**；**⭐ 而一句最值得抄的话**：**「**a stale pair describes a model that no longer exists**」**；**⚠️ 许可为** Etalab 开放许可 2.0**（**须署名**）**
e.title_en: A French academic competition dataset for predicting the pure fire premium on a farm multi-risk policy, whose target is decomposed into a frequency term, an average claim cost term and a policy-age exposure term, scored against a generalised-linear-model benchmark, and whose description warns that a stale pair of derived prediction files describes a model that no longer exists.
e.title_hk: **法國農業多風險保單的**火災純保費**預測競賽：把目標拆成**頻率 × 案均 × 年數****：Kaggle 資料集 `mariodefrance/caa-challenge-2025`——**⭐ 逐字副標題**「**AssurPrime — ENS Challenge Data #161 (Crédit Agricole Assurances)**」**；**⭐ 目標逐字分解為** `CHARGE = FREQ × CM × ANNEE_ASSURANCE`**，**並要求兩個模型**（**頻率用 Poisson／log、**案均用 Tweedie／log**）**對** GLM 基準**算 RMSE**；**⭐ 而一句最值得抄的話**：**「**a stale pair describes a model that no longer exists**」**；**⚠️ 許可為** Etalab 開放許可 2.0**（**須署名**）**
e.summary: **assurprime-ens-challenge**（Kaggle 数据集 `mariodefrance/caa-challenge-2025`，**逐字副标题**「**AssurPrime — ENS Challenge Data #161 (Crédit Agricole Assurances)**」）**是一份**法国农业多风险保单的火灾纯保费预测竞赛的工作数据与中间产物****——**逐字自述任务为**「**predict the pure fire premium on Pacifica的 Contrat Multirisque Agricole, the multi-risk policy French farmers take out to cover their holding**」**，**并逐字给出目标分解**「**`CHARGE = FREQ x CM x ANNEE_ASSURANCE`**」**与评分口径**「**scored on RMSE against a GLM benchmark (Poisson/log for frequency, Tweedie/log for severity)**」**。**本次实测**：**最后更新 2026-09-06**、**版本 2**、**1,826,672,247 字节（**约 1.83 GB**）**、**可用性评分 **0.94****、**下载 7 次、**浏览 14 次**；**标签逐字含** `classification`、`insurance`、`regression`、`agriculture`、`europe`**；**⭐ 许可字段为**「**Other (specified in description)**」**，**而描述逐字给出**「**Etalab Licence Ouverte / Open Licence 2.0**」**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**数据的来路：竞赛**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得看**：**① **目标被拆成两个可分别建模的因子 ＋ 一个暴露量**；**② **哪些文件是竞赛原件、**哪些是**派生中间产物**被分开写明****；**③ **许可的认定路径被逐条引用**（**含平台使用条款第 **4.6.1** 条**）。**⚠️ 本次未下载任何文件。
e.summary_hk: **assurprime-ens-challenge**（Kaggle 資料集 `mariodefrance/caa-challenge-2025`，**逐字副標題**「**AssurPrime — ENS Challenge Data #161 (Crédit Agricole Assurances)**」）**是一份**法國農業多風險保單的火災純保費預測競賽的工作資料與中間產物****——**逐字自述任務為**「**predict the pure fire premium on Pacifica的 Contrat Multirisque Agricole**」**，**並逐字給出目標分解**「**`CHARGE = FREQ x CM x ANNEE_ASSURANCE`**」**與評分口徑**「**scored on RMSE against a GLM benchmark (Poisson/log for frequency, Tweedie/log for severity)**」**。**本次實測**：**最後更新 2026-09-06**、**版本 2**、**約 1.83 GB**、**可用性評分 0.94**、**下載 7 次、**瀏覽 14 次**；**標籤逐字含** `classification`、`insurance`、`regression`、`agriculture`、`europe`**；**⭐ 許可欄位為**「**Other (specified in description)**」**，**而描述逐字給出**「**Etalab Licence Ouverte / Open Licence 2.0**」**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**資料的來路：競賽**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三處最值得看**：**① **目標被拆成兩個可分別建模的因子 ＋ 一個暴露量**；**② **哪些檔案是競賽原件、**哪些是**派生中間產物**被分開寫明****；**③ **許可的認定路徑被逐條引用**（**含平台使用條款第 **4.6.1** 條**）。**⚠️ 本次未下載任何檔案。
e.summary_en: The Kaggle dataset caa-challenge-2025 **holds the working data and intermediate artefacts of an academic competition to predict the pure fire premium on a French farm multi-risk policy**, proposed by a large French insurer through a higher-education challenge platform, and identifies the target verbatim as decomposing into a frequency factor, an average claim cost factor and an exposure factor, with two models scored against a generalised-linear-model benchmark on root mean squared error. **Measured this round**: **last updated 2026-09-06**, **version 2**, **about 1.83 gigabytes**, **a usability rating of about 0.94**, seven downloads and fourteen views, tagged as classification, insurance, regression, agriculture and Europe, and licensed as other with terms specified in the description, which states the Etalab open licence with attribution. **This entry belongs to the round theme of where data comes from, in this case a competition**, and **three things are worth reading: the target is split into two separately modelled factors plus an exposure term; the files that are competition originals are separated from the files that are derived intermediate artefacts; and the licensing reasoning is cited clause by clause, including an article of the platform terms of use**. **No file was downloaded this round.**
e.body:
**assurprime-ens-challenge**（Kaggle 数据集 `mariodefrance/caa-challenge-2025`，**逐字标题为** `caa-challenge-2025`，**逐字副标题为**「**AssurPrime — ENS Challenge Data #161 (Crédit Agricole Assurances)**」**）**是一份**法国农业多风险保单（**Contrat Multirisque Agricole**）火灾纯保费预测竞赛的工作数据与中间产物****——**逐字自述任务为**「**The task: predict the pure fire premium on Pacifica的 *Contrat Multirisque Agricole*, the multi-risk policy French farmers take out to cover their holding. Fire is the dominant share of that contract的 claim burden.**」**。**本次实测**：**最后更新 2026-09-06**、**版本 2**、**1,826,672,247 字节**、**可用性评分 **0.94****、**下载 7 次、**浏览 14 次、**公开 notebook 2 个**；**所有者与创建者为同一人**（`Mario Defrance`**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**数据的来路：竞赛**」**。

**⭐ 引号约定**：**本条目所引法语机构名中原为 ASCII 撇号者一律写成弯撇号**（**U+2019**）**，**以便与条目自身的引号区分**。

**可核实信息（均 Kaggle 数据集页元数据与描述实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 目标被拆成**两个可分别建模的因子 ＋ 一个暴露量****——**逐字**：**「**The target decomposes as `CHARGE = FREQ x CM x ANNEE_ASSURANCE` so the challenge asks for two models — one for **frequency** (`FREQ`), one for **average claim cost** (`CM`) — scored on **RMSE against a GLM benchmark** (Poisson/log for frequency, Tweedie/log for severity).**」**，**并逐字补一句可核的恒等式**：**「**On rows with a claim, `CHARGE / CM` is exactly `FREQ * ANNEE_ASSURANCE`, an integer 1–5.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**「**一个纯保费**」**被拆成**频率 × 案均 × 暴露年数**，**而**暴露量**在保单年数上取整数 1 至 5**——**⭐ 这是**车险与农险都通用的**频次／案均分解**，**而**这里把**暴露定义写成了一个可验证的等式**；**⭐ 这与本站第 330 轮「**假设**」、第 340 轮「**把每个数从哪来写在旁边**」同向**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 「**哪些是竞赛原件、**哪些是派生中间产物**」被分开写明****——**逐字**：**「**`frequency_2026.csv`, `oos_frequency_2026.csv` and `cm_carver_freq_tschuprowt_2026.json` are **not challenge originals** — they are produced by the frequency notebook and consumed by the severity notebook. **Regenerate them whenever the frequency model changes; a stale pair describes a model that no longer exists.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**最后半句是整个描述里最值得抄的一句**：**⭐ 即**「**一份过期的派生文件，描述的是一个已经不存在的模型**」**——**⭐ 这与本站第 350 轮「**来源与生成物**」、第 352 轮「**登记与出处**」同向**，**且**它给出了**为什么**要重算的理由**，**而**不只是**一句「**记得更新**」。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 许可的认定路径被**逐条引用****——**逐字**：**「**Every file here is redistributed under the **Etalab Licence Ouverte / Open Licence 2.0**, which permits reproduction, redistribution, adaptation and commercial reuse subject to **attribution**. **Challenge files** (`train_input_Z61KlZo.csv`, `train_output_DzPxaPY.csv`, `test_input_5qJzHrr.csv`) — Study Data from ENS Challenge Data #161. Per the platform的 terms of use article **4.6.1**, Study Data is open under the Etalab Licence Ouverte **by default unless the provider specifies otherwise in the challenge description**; challenge #161 specifies nothing, so **the default applies**.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**「**这份数据为什么可以再分发**」**不是**一句「**开放数据**」，**而是**一条可追溯的推理**（**平台条款默认项 ＋ 该竞赛未另行指定**）**——**⭐ 这与本站第 354 轮「**存证**」、第 357 轮「**许可形态分类**」同向**：**许可结论要能追回它依据的条款**。**⭐⭐ ④ 归属被分成**三个来源**逐条写明**——**逐字**：**① **竞赛文件**（**Study Data from ENS Challenge Data #161**），**生产者逐字为**「**Producer: Crédit Agricole Assurances, via ENS Challenge Data**」**，**来源网址 **`challengedata.ens.fr/challenges/161`**，**最后更新 **2024-12-05****；**② **`Incendies.csv`** 来自** BDIFF（**法国全国森林火灾数据库**）**，**生产者逐字为**「**Institut national de l’information géographique et forestière (IGN), for the Ministère de l’Agriculture et de la Souveraineté Alimentaire**」**，**覆盖 **2006–2022**、**每年更新**、**上游最后更新 **2025-12-13**、**抽取日 **2025-03-21****；**③ **派生产物**「**carry the same terms**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得抄**：**⭐ 即**三份来源**各自给出**生产者、**来源网址与两个日期**（**上游更新日与本地抽取日**）**——**⭐ 而**「**抽取日**」**这一栏**正是**数据可复现的关键**；**⭐ 这与本站第 344 轮「**把依据放在看得见的地方**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 变量族被分类写明，**并解释为什么有些列名**没有意义****——**逐字**：**目标**（`FREQ`／`CM`／`CHARGE`**）**；**暴露**（`ANNEE_ASSURANCE`，**逐字** years since the contract was taken out**）**；**地理**（**department ＋ **weather/climate aggregates**）**；**合同**（**被保险人活动如 `cultivateur`／`polyculteur`、**保障订阅标记、**建筑数、**员工数、**承保时已申报的赔案**）**；**⭐ 以及面积／**保额／**防护**三族**被逐字说明为**匿名化**：**「**The provider **anonymised these into `surface1..n`, `capital1..n`, `prev1..n`** for confidentiality; **the names carry no meaning by design**.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一句值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**「**这些列名不是缩写，**而是**刻意没有含义**」**——**⭐ 若不写这一句，**使用者会**花时间去猜 `surface3` 是什么**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 特征工程里**外部数据的接入点**被写明**——**逐字**：**`Incendies.csv`**（**BDIFF** 抽取，**24 列**）「**Joined during feature engineering to build the burnt-area and extinction-rate features (`total_surface_2023`, `total_surface_5y`, `surface_over_forest`, `fire_extinction_rates`). **Not part of the challenge distribution.**」**。**⭐ 即**「**这四个特征是我自己加的、**不在竞赛数据里**」**被写明**——**⭐ 而这在竞赛语境下尤其重要**：**读者要能分清**哪些是**出题方给的**、**哪些是**参赛者加的**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 建模路径被一句话概括，**且**朝向**基准可比****——**逐字**：**「**The approach these artefacts come from carves every qualitative feature with **AutoCarver** and tunes **XGBoost with Optuna**, weighting the severity model的 samples by the frequency model的 absolute error.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**「**用频率模型的绝对误差给严重度模型的样本加权**」**这一处值得记**：**⭐ 即**两个模型**不是各自独立**，**而是**一个的输出**被用作另一个的权重**；**⭐ 而**这也解释了**为什么上一条要强调**派生文件过期即失效**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 工程形态可数**：**实测描述列出**三个**未改动的竞赛文件**（`train_input_Z61KlZo.csv` 逐字为 **one row per policy-year, keyed on `ID`**、`train_output_DzPxaPY.csv` 含 `ANNEE_ASSURANCE`／`FREQ`／`CM`／`CHARGE`、`test_input_5qJzHrr.csv`**）**，**以及三份派生文件**（**序列化的 AutoCarver `BinaryCarver`（**light mode**），**逐字** `CM` carved against the frequency target with **Tschuprow的 T**，**用于**按案均金额分布分层切分训练／验证**；**两份频率预测**，**逐字** `pred_sum` is the expected claim count**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**用 Tschuprow 的 T 去分层切分**这一细节值得记**：**⭐ 即**切分不是随机**，**而是**按目标分布分层**——**⭐ 这与本站第 356 轮那条「**Never a random split**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[porto-seguro-competition]]、**[[allstate-claims-severity]] 覆盖车险与赔案竞赛数据集**，**[[actuarial-student-competitions]] 覆盖精算学生竞赛**，**[[agrisky-ai]] 覆盖农业风险一侧**，**[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]、**[[motor-pricing-glm]]、**[[openrater]]、**[[ratecraft]] 覆盖定价与 GLM**，**[[casdatasets]]、**[[ads-tutorials]] 覆盖公开数据与教程**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一份**由保险公司出题、**由高校平台主办**的农险定价竞赛工作包**：目标分解 ＋ **原件与派生分开 ＋ **许可依据可追**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[porto-seguro-competition]]、[[agrisky-ai]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的五点**：**① 纯保费**拆成频率 × 案均 × 暴露**，**并把暴露定义写成**可验证的等式**；**② **原件与派生文件**分开列，**并说明**过期即失效**；**③ **许可结论**要能追回它依据的**条款**；**④ **外部数据接入的特征**要标明**不在原始数据里**；**⑤ **匿名化列名**要点明**「**没有含义**」**，**免得别人去猜**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有下载该数据集的任何文件**（**未取三个竞赛 CSV、**未取 `Incendies.csv`、**未取任何派生文件、**未跑任何模型**），**故**不主张**其数据规模、**字段取值与任何模型表现**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何文件的正文**——**本次只读 Kaggle 数据集页的**元数据与描述**；**未打开**描述中提到的挑战页面（`challengedata.ens.fr/challenges/161`**）、**平台的**使用条款第 4.6.1 条**、**`Incendies.csv`、**BDIFF **数据集页**，**也**未核对** `train_input` **等文件的列名**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**「**平台条款默认采用 Etalab 开放许可**」**这一认定****（**⭐ 本词条**只转述描述中的推理**，**未读条款原文**）**；**⭐ 故**这份数据**能否再分发**，**本条**不作结论**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**该竞赛的**完整题目、**评分细节与排行榜**（**未访问挑战页面**）**；**也未核实**其**是否仍在进行**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实** `CHARGE / CM` **等于 **`FREQ * ANNEE_ASSURANCE`** 这一恒等式**（**⭐ 只转述描述**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实** Pacifica **与** Crédit Agricole Assurances **的关系与产品细节**（**⭐ 描述称该保单为**农场多风险保单**，**本词条**只转述**）**；**⚠️ 并如实指出**：**这是一份**竞赛用数据**，**不得**当作任何真实保单的费率或经验**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实** BDIFF **的覆盖与更新节奏**（**⭐ 描述称** 2006–2022、**每年更新、**上游最后更新 **2025-12-13****，**本次**未访问该数据库页**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核实**作者身份与所属**（**数据集所有者 **`Mario Defrance`** 可能是一个**参赛队或个人账号**，**⭐ 描述逐字称这些产物是**「**working data, plus the intermediate artefacts needed to re-run a full two-stage pricing model**」**）**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目的**主体性质**须说清**：**⭐ 它**不是**一个软件工具**，**而是**一份**竞赛数据与中间产物集合****（**⭐ 本词条据此把** `kind` **记为** `dataset`**）**。**⑩ ⚠️ 未核实**该数据集与**竞赛官方发布**是否一致**（**⭐ 描述称三个竞赛文件**未改动**，**但本次**未与原站比对**）**。**⑪ ⚠️ 本条目的**窗口状况**：**⭐ 数据集**最后更新 **2026-09-06**（**在解冻窗口之内**）**，**而**竞赛本身由其生产者页面显示**最后更新 **2024-12-05****（**远在窗口之外**）**——**⭐ 本词条**如实并列这两个日期**，**并指出**本条收录的是**在窗口内被更新／被发布的这一份工作包**，**而不是**新出的竞赛**。**⑫ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。

**assurprime-ens-challenge**（Kaggle 資料集 `mariodefrance/caa-challenge-2025`，**逐字標題** `caa-challenge-2025`，**逐字副標題**「**AssurPrime — ENS Challenge Data #161 (Crédit Agricole Assurances)**」**）**是一份**法國農業多風險保單（Contrat Multirisque Agricole）火災純保費預測競賽的工作資料與中間產物****——**逐字自述任務為**「**The task: predict the pure fire premium on Pacifica的 Contrat Multirisque Agricole, the multi-risk policy French farmers take out to cover their holding. Fire is the dominant share of that contract的 claim burden.**」**。**本次實測**：**最後更新 2026-09-06**、**版本 2**、**1,826,672,247 位元組**、**可用性評分 0.94**、**下載 7 次、**瀏覽 14 次、**公開 notebook 2 個**；**所有者與創建者同為一人**（`Mario Defrance`**）**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**資料的來路：競賽**」**。

**⭐ 引號約定**：**本條目所引法語機構名中原為 ASCII 撇號者一律寫成彎撇號**（**U+2019**）**。

The Kaggle dataset caa-challenge-2025, subtitled as a challenge from a French higher-education challenge platform proposed by a large French insurer, **holds the working data and intermediate artefacts of a competition to predict the pure fire premium on a French farm multi-risk policy**, described verbatim as predicting the pure fire premium on the multi-risk policy French farmers take out to cover their holding, where fire is the dominant share of that contract claim burden. **Measured this round**: **last updated 2026-09-06**, **version 2**, **about 1.83 gigabytes**, **a usability rating of about 0.94**, seven downloads, fourteen views and two public notebooks, owned and created by the same person. **This entry belongs to the round theme of where data comes from, in this case a competition.**

**Quotation convention**: apostrophes inside the quoted French institution names are reproduced with a typographic apostrophe so that they are distinguishable from the quotation marks of this entry itself.

**Verified information, all measured from the dataset page metadata and description**: **first, the target is split into two separately modelled factors plus an exposure term**: verbatim, the target decomposes into a total cost equal to frequency times average claim cost times an age-of-contract exposure, so the challenge asks for two models, one for frequency and one for average claim cost, scored on root mean squared error against a generalised-linear-model benchmark using a log link for frequency under a Poisson assumption and for severity under a Tweedie assumption; and the description adds a checkable identity verbatim, that on rows with a claim the ratio of total cost to average claim cost is exactly frequency times the exposure, an integer between one and five. **A pure premium is decomposed into frequency, average cost and exposure, and the exposure definition is written as an equality anyone can test.** **Second, the files that are competition originals are separated from those that are derived**: verbatim, three named files are not challenge originals but are produced by the frequency notebook and consumed by the severity notebook, and they must be regenerated whenever the frequency model changes because a stale pair describes a model that no longer exists. **That last clause is the most copyable sentence in the description: a stale derived file describes a model that no longer exists, which gives the reason for regenerating rather than merely instructing it.** **Third, the licensing reasoning is cited clause by clause**: verbatim, every file is redistributed under the Etalab open licence, which permits reproduction, redistribution, adaptation and commercial reuse subject to attribution, and the challenge files are study data from the challenge platform where, per the platform terms of use article four point six point one, study data is open under the Etalab licence by default unless the provider specifies otherwise in the challenge description, and since this challenge specifies nothing the default applies. **Why the data may be redistributed is therefore a traceable argument resting on a named clause plus the absence of a contrary specification, rather than a bare assertion that the data is open.** **Fourth, attribution is split across three sources**: the challenge files, produced by a named insurer through the platform; a separate fire database file whose producer is stated as a national geographic and forestry institute acting for the agriculture ministry, with a stated coverage period, annual update cadence, an upstream update date and a local extraction date; and the derived artefacts, which carry the same terms. **Each source carries a producer, a source address and two dates, and the extraction date is precisely what makes the join reproducible.** **Fifth, the variable families are classified and the reason some column names carry no meaning is given**: targets, exposure defined verbatim as years since the contract was taken out, geography as department plus weather and climate aggregates, contract attributes covering the insured activity, guarantee subscription flags, building count, employee count and claims declared at underwriting, and three families covering surfaces, insured capital and protective equipment which the description states were anonymised into numbered columns for confidentiality, with the names carrying no meaning by design. **Saying that the column names are meaningless by construction stops a reader from spending time guessing what a numbered surface column means.** **Sixth, the point where external data enters the feature engineering is stated**: a forest-fire database extract with twenty-four columns was joined during feature engineering to build burnt-area and extinction-rate features, and the description states plainly that it is not part of the challenge distribution. **In a competition this matters, because a reader must be able to tell what the organisers supplied from what the entrant added.** **Seventh, the modelling route is summarised in one sentence**: the approach carves every qualitative feature with a named carving library and tunes gradient boosting with a named optimiser, weighting the severity samples by the absolute error of the frequency model. **The two models are not independent, since the output of one becomes a weight in the other, which is also why the derived files must not go stale.** **Eighth, the engineering shape is countable**: three unmodified competition files, one keyed per policy-year, one carrying the four target and exposure columns, and one out-of-sample covariate file; plus three derived files, a serialised carving configuration produced by carving the average claim cost against the frequency target using a named association measure and used to stratify the train and development split by the claim-amount distribution, and two frequency prediction files whose summed prediction is stated to be the expected claim count. **Stratifying the split by the target distribution rather than splitting at random is worth noting.** **Ninth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover competition datasets for motor insurance and claim severity, student actuarial competitions, agricultural risk, pricing models and generalised linear models, and public datasets with tutorials, **while this entry supplies a competition working package set by an insurer and hosted by an academic platform, with a decomposed target, originals separated from derived files, and a traceable licensing argument. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled motor insurance competition dataset and the pooled agricultural risk entry**; **five practices transfer directly: decompose a pure premium into frequency, average cost and exposure and write the exposure definition as a checkable equality; list originals separately from derived files and say why a stale derived file is worse than useless; make a licensing conclusion traceable to the clause it rests on; mark features that came from external data as absent from the original distribution; and state that anonymised column names are meaningless by design**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no file from the dataset was downloaded** — none of the three competition files, not the fire database extract, no derived file and no model run — **so this entry claims nothing about data scale, field values or any model performance**. **Second, no file body was read**: only the dataset page metadata and description were read, and the challenge page, the platform terms of use article, the fire database extract and the source record for that database were not opened, nor were the column names of the competition files checked; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the argument that the platform terms default to the Etalab licence was not verified**, this entry relaying the reasoning in the description without reading the clause, **and this entry therefore draws no conclusion about whether the data may be redistributed**. **Fourth, the complete challenge statement, the scoring detail and any leaderboard were not verified, nor was whether the challenge is still running. Fifth, the stated identity linking total cost, average claim cost, frequency and exposure was not verified.** **Sixth, the relationship between the named insurer brand and the group was not verified, nor were product details**, and **this entry states plainly that this is competition data and must not be treated as the rate or experience of any real policy**. **Seventh, the coverage and update cadence of the fire database were not verified**, its page not having been visited. **Eighth, the author identity and affiliation were not verified**, the owner possibly being a competing team or an individual. **Ninth, the nature of this item must be stated plainly: it is not a software tool but a set of competition data and intermediate artefacts**, and its kind is recorded as a dataset accordingly. **Tenth, whether this dataset matches the official competition release was not verified**, the description stating that the three competition files are unmodified. **Eleventh, on the window: the dataset was last updated 2026-09-06, inside the thaw window, while the producer page for the challenge states a last update of 2024-12-05, far outside it, so what is collected here is a working package updated inside the window rather than a newly created competition. Twelfth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**
